description: This file provides asynchronous functions for managing comments within a task management system, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting comments, with access control and activity recording.

methods.name: Task _ensure_member_and_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Ensures that the user is a member of the project and that the task exists within the project.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists comments for a specified task within a project if the user has access.

methods.name: Comment create_comment(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, body: str)
methods.description: Creates a new comment on a task by an authorized project member, then records activity and notifies via websockets.

methods.name: Comment update_comment(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, comment_id: int, user_id: int, body: str)
methods.description: Updates the body of an existing comment if the user is the author, then records activity and notifies.

methods.name: None delete_comment(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, comment_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a comment if the user is the author, then records activity and notifies.

calls: select(Comment).where(Comment.id == comment_id, Comment.project_id == project_id, Comment.task_id == task_id)
